carrier_contract.failure_semantics: A missing, unreadable, non-UTF-8, or invalid-JSON carrier is invalid_input and preserves output.
carrier_contract.literal_form: --chunks accepts the frozen literal CHUNKS_JSON form unchanged.
carrier_contract.path_form: --chunks @PATH reads the exact UTF-8 CHUNKS_JSON bytes from caller-supplied PATH before applying the identical strict JSON, hexadecimal, and 2 MiB validation.
carrier_contract.semantic_effect: The carrier changes transport only; chunk boundaries, decoded bytes, limits, parser semantics, checks, mutants, and endpoint remain unchanged.

reason: A valid near-limit hexadecimal CHUNKS_JSON value exceeds Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN, so the frozen semantic domain cannot be exercised through one argv element alone.
